description: This file contains functions for resolving agent identities, reactions, message prefixes, response prefixes, and human delay configurations within the OpenClaw system. It manages configuration lookups and fallback logic for agent-related messaging behaviors.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdentity
methods.description: Resolves the identity configuration for a given agent ID based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: resolveAckReaction
methods.description: Determines the acknowledgment reaction emoji or string for an agent, considering channel, account, and global settings, with a fallback to a default emoji.

methods.name: resolveIdentityNamePrefix
methods.description: Returns the identity name enclosed in brackets for template use, or undefined if no name is set.

methods.name: resolveIdentityName
methods.description: Returns the identity name without brackets for template context.

methods.name: resolveMessagePrefix
methods.description: Determines the message prefix string for an agent, considering configuration, allow-from flag, and fallback.

methods.name: resolveResponsePrefix
methods.description: Determines the response prefix string for an agent, considering channel, account, and global configuration, with support for 'auto' setting.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveMessagesConfig
methods.description: Returns an object with message and response prefixes based on configuration and context.

methods.name: resolveHumanDelayConfig
methods.description: Resolves the human delay configuration for an agent, combining defaults and overrides.
